walkthroughs.body_html:
Elements Of Computational Thinking — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Elements Of Computational Thinking brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Elements Of Computational Thinking.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: Because UDP is always faster than TCP.

mcqs.q: What is the main advantage of asymmetric encryption?
options: Secure key exchange without sharing a secret in advance.
Because UDP is always faster than TCP.
It is impossible to break.

mcqs.q: Why is UDP used for live video streaming despite being unreliable?
options: Because TCP cannot handle video data.
Lower overhead and latency - retransmitting late packets would harm real-time quality.
It is impossible to break.
Because UDP is always faster than TCP.
